title: Pure Armed Dragon
summary: The page's 2026 ratios without the Dragon Rulers, so Armed Dragon cards with generic staples. The Thunder Armed Dragons send a monster from the hand to level up into the next Armed Dragon from the Deck, and each pays you back when it is sent to the GY for a Dragon's effect. The Burst Protocol cards lead: Drill Armed Dragon banishes WIND Dragons to search a Dragon of that Level, and Fist Armed Dragon destroys a monster (your own, to summon a Dragon two Levels higher) and revives itself from the GY. Pile Armed Dragon summons itself and fuels the GY.
main: Drill Armed Dragon
2026 support. Banishes WIND or Level 7+ Dragons to search a Dragon of that Level; discards to pump WIND Dragons.
Fist Armed Dragon
2026 support. Discards to destroy a monster, summoning a Dragon two Levels higher if it was yours; revives itself.
Pile Armed Dragon
Discards a WIND Dragon to summon itself; mills an Armed Dragon to pump a monster.
Armed Dragon Thunder LV3
Sends a monster to level up into a Level 5 or lower Armed Dragon; draws when used as a cost.
Armed Dragon Thunder LV5
Levels up into a Level 7 or lower Armed Dragon; used as a cost, searches a Level 5+ WIND Dragon.
Armed Dragon Thunder LV7
Levels up into a Level 10 or lower Armed Dragon; used as a cost, searches an Armed Dragon card.
Armed Dragon Thunder LV10
Summoned by an Armed Dragon: grows protections and destroys a card on their turn.
Knight Armed Dragon, the Armored Knight Dragon
Joins when you summon a Level 5+ Dragon; copies a banished Dragon's Level.
Armed Dragon, the Armored Dragon
Summons a Level 5 or lower WIND Dragon after destroying a monster in battle.
Armed Dragon Flash
Quick-Play: summons a Level 3 Armed Dragon from the Deck.
Armed Dragon Blitz
Adds or summons a copy of an Armed Dragon you control.
Armed Dragon Lightning
Protects Armed Dragons and returns one from the GY.
Armed Dragon Thunderbolt
Pumps an Armed Dragon for each lower Armed Dragon in the GY.
